name: Tandhan Industries Limited
about: Tandhan Industries Limited engages in commercial service, trading, and marketing of various goods in India. The company is involved in the trading of a diverse portfolio of products, including textiles, cotton, jute, synthetic goods, engineering items, chemicals, paper, electrical equipment, machinery, and related materials. It also provides comprehensive facility management services such as pest control, sanitation, lawn care, and general maintenance; and security solutions, including deployment of security personnel, installation of electronic alarm and surveillance systems, private investigations, and security consulting services. The company was formerly known as Sanmitra Commercial Limited and changed its name to Tandhan Industries Limited in February 2026. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.
